exact_historical_statement: For every fixed direction l on the unit sphere in Z^d, does an iid elliptic nearest-neighbor RWRE have annealed P_0(A_l) in {0,1}, where A_l is directional transience X_n·l -> +infinity? The unresolved range in the 2013 source was d>=3.

historical_source.authors: Alexander Drewitz and Alejandro F. Ramirez
historical_source.title: Selected Topics in Random Walks in Random Environment
historical_source.locator: Open question 3.2 and equation (3.2), arXiv:1309.2589v1, 2013; definitions 2.1-2.3
historical_source.source_quote_short: Consider a RWRE satisfying the assumptions (E) and (IID).

assumptions.E: all nearest-neighbor transition probabilities strictly positive almost surely
assumptions.IID: transition rows at lattice sites independent and identically distributed
assumptions.direction: each fixed nonzero direction, normalized in source to unit sphere
